title: 636017 Move Inventory report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Report action tooltips for 11 inventory reports are moved from page actions to the report objects themselves, removing duplicate tooltip definitions across pages and role centers in the W1 and country layers.
key_points: 11 inventory reports now define their tooltip on the report object instead of on page actions
In W1, 21 duplicate action tooltips were removed across 7 pages and role centers
In 18 country layers, the matching page forks were cleaned as well
Page actions inherit the report tooltip through the 2025 release wave 1 UI descriptor feature
The Inventory area tooltip migration is now complete; the change is metadata only
quote: The tooltip is now defined once on the report and applies wherever the report is invoked.
